name: session-companion
description: Unofficial chat UI for Claude Code sessions, with cross-repo session history across every repo on your machine. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic.

chatSessions.name: session-companion
chatSessions.description: Chat UI for Claude Code sessions, with cross-repo session history
chatSessions.welcomeMessage: Skeleton session — round-trips a static prompt to the Claude Agent SDK.

sessionCompanion.excludedFolders.description: Sessions whose working directory is inside one of these folders are hidden from the cross-repo Sessions list. Defaults to /tmp, which mostly accumulates throwaway/scratch sessions.

sessionCompanion.fallbackModel.description: Model to automatically retry with if the primary model is overloaded or unavailable (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5"). Leave empty to disable. The primary model is re-tried at the start of each new turn.

sessionCompanion.maxBudgetUsd.description: Stop a chat automatically once its cumulative cost exceeds this many US dollars. 0 disables the cap.

sessionCompanion.maxTurns.description: Stop a chat automatically after this many conversation turns (a turn is one user message plus the assistant's response). 0 disables the cap.

enumDescriptions: Add the folder to this window's workspace and open the chat here, inline.
Open a separate VS Code window scoped to that folder.
sessionCompanion.crossRepoOpenBehavior.description: Opening a past chat tied to a folder that isn't part of this window's workspace: add that folder here and stay in this window, or open a separate VS Code window for it. Has no effect when the folder is already part of this window's workspace — that case always opens inline here regardless of this setting.
